notes.title: DEVLOG #17
notes.content:
Helloooo everyone,

Today I improved the customization options for our store and factory signage. And I know the image in the prologue version was very annoying. The color tones and look felt very cheap. 

Now we can adjust the font size to our liking. There will be many new features like light color, light brightness, outer frame color, inner background color, text color. 

I need your advice for this customization screen, which camera angle do you think is more beautiful? Or if there is an angle you think would be better, you can recommend :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45014966/5d0e8827b03a65135813bfbb1efddbc00d03c6ef.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45014966/81431899d1137a082a3ffb415c2dce057c254307.png[/img]


In addition to these;
-Now we will be able to give customers more or less money. 
-I turned off the interaction with other objects while interacting with the cash register.
-I seriously improved the vehicle mechanics. 
-Player movement has been significantly improved and there is no more unnecessary flying and most importantly, it's not nauseating (I did it from scratch)
-Customers are paying more realistic prices.
- When buying raw materials, we don't increase them by clicking on the button one by one, in addition, I added keyboard input there.
-I activated driver support in low quality settings (computer wouldn't turn on, I apologize).
-The store ceiling was too low. We received a lot of feedback on this and now we have a more spacious environment.
-Cost of production is gone (but the game is more difficult now)
-I'm continuing many bug fixes and improvements like these. Level design will be a lot of fun. :)
